items.title_zh: 华为下周发布 Pura X Max，其首款阔折叠手机
items.summary: Huawei said it will launch the Pura X Max on April 20, describing it as the industry's first horizontally wide foldable smartphone.

items.title: Alibaba’s Amap to launch first embodied robot, starting with robotic dog
items.raw_content: Alibaba’s subsidiary Amap (Gaode) is set to release its first product from its embodied intelligence division—a quadruped robot. This is reportedly the
items.title_zh: 阿里旗下高德将推出首款具身智能机器人，从机器狗起步
items.summary: Alibaba's Amap (Gaode) is reportedly set to release a quadruped robot, the first product from its embodied intelligence division.

items.title_zh: NIST 放弃对大多数 CVE 的丰富化处理
items.summary: NIST announced on Wednesday a new policy for the US National Vulnerability Database, with Risky Business reporting that the agency is giving up enrichment of most CVE records.

items.title: Vercel April 2026 security incident
items.title_zh: Vercel 2026 年 4 月安全事件
items.summary: Vercel published a bulletin on an April 2026 security incident, which BleepingComputer reports as a confirmed breach, with hackers claiming to sell stolen data.

items.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B: Agentic coding power, now open to all
items.raw_content: Qwen offers comprehensive functionality spanning chatbot, image and video understanding, image generation, document processing, web search integration, tool utilization, and artifacts.
items.title_zh: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B：Agent 编程能力，向所有人开放
items.summary: Qwen released Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, presented as bringing agentic coding power and now open to all. The blog lists capabilities spanning chatbot, image and video understanding, image generation, document processing, web search, tool use and artifacts.

items.title: AI could be the end of the digital wave, not the next big thing
items.title_zh: AI 可能是数字浪潮的终点，而非下一个大事件
items.summary: The post argues that the AI boom is more likely a marker of the end of the 50-year digital boom than the start of a new wave of innovation.

items.title: Show HN: I built a social media management tool in 3 weeks with Claude and Codex
items.title_zh: Show HN：我用 Claude 和 Codex 在三周内做出社交媒体管理工具
items.summary: Brightbean Studio is an open-source, self-hostable social media management platform that lets users schedule and publish content across more than ten platforms from a single dashboard. The author says it was built in three weeks with Claude and Codex as a free alternative to services such as Buffer and Sendible.

items.title: An AI Vibe Coding Horror Story
items.title_zh: 一个 AI 氛围编程恐怖故事
items.summary: A medical professional reportedly built a patient-management app with AI that left all patient data exposed unprotected on the internet and sent voice recordings to AI services without consent, potentially violating Swiss nDSG and other laws.

items.title: Rare concert recordings are landing on the Internet Archive
items.title_zh: 珍稀演唱会录音正陆续进入 Internet Archive
items.summary: Chicago-based music fan Aadam Jacobs, who has recorded concerts since the 1980s, has amassed an archive of more than 10,000 tapes that are being added to the Internet Archive.

items.title: Does Gas Town 'steal' usage from users' LLM credits to improve itself?
items.title_zh: Gas Town 是否在“窃取”用户的 LLM 额度来提升自己？
items.summary: A GitHub issue says Gas Town's release formula files cause local installs to review open issues through GitHub Actions, consuming usage from users' subscribed LLM credits, and asks whether the tool is taking that usage to improve itself.

items.title: The Future of Everything Is Lies, I Guess: New Jobs
items.title_zh: 未来一切皆是谎言，我猜：新职业
items.summary: The essay predicts that broader ML deployment will create new kinds of work at the human–ML boundary, including prompt specialists, process and statistical engineers, model trainers, people who take accountability when systems fail, and interpreters of model behavior.

items.title: Game devs explain the tricks involved with letting you pause a game
items.title_zh: 游戏开发者揭秘让游戏暂停背后的门道
items.summary: Game developers explain how they make a game stop and start when a player presses a button, offering insight into the various tricks involved.

items.title: Claude Design
items.title_zh: Anthropic Labs 发布 Claude Design
items.summary: Anthropic Labs has announced Claude Design on the company's news page.

items.title: Show HN: PanicLock – Close your MacBook lid disable TouchID –> password unlock
items.title_zh: Show HN：PanicLock——合上 MacBook 上盖即禁用 Touch ID，改用密码解锁
items.summary: A developer built PanicLock to disable Touch ID when a MacBook lid is closed, forcing a password unlock, citing a case in which a Washington Post reporter was compelled to unlock her computer with her fingerprint.

items.title: Migrating from DigitalOcean to Hetzner
items.title_zh: 从 DigitalOcean 迁移到 Hetzner
items.summary: A production migration moved 248GB of MySQL data across 30 databases, 34 Nginx sites, GitLab EE and Neo4j from DigitalOcean to Hetzner dedicated servers with zero downtime while serving live mobile app traffic.

items.title: The quiet disappearance of the free-range childhood
items.title_zh: 自由放养式童年的悄然消失
items.summary: An essay looks at the quiet decline of free-range childhood, when children play and move around without constant adult supervision.

items.title: Modern Rendering Culling Techniques
items.title_zh: 现代渲染剔除技术
items.summary: Drawing on work on Saints Row: The Third Remastered, the author argues that despite AI coding tools, DLSS 5, Unreal Engine 5 and Gaussian-splat demos, games still depend on hard engineering work such as culling.

items.title: Windows Server 2025 Runs Better on ARM
items.title_zh: Windows Server 2025 在 ARM 上表现更好
items.summary: After building a Windows Server 2025 Hyper-V lab on a 14th-gen Intel Core i9 machine, the author repeated the setup on a Snapdragon X Elite system using an ARM image generated with UUP dump, since Microsoft offers no official ARM ISO. The author reports that the ARM version ran better.

items.title: All elementary functions from a single binary operator
items.title_zh: 用单一二元运算符生成所有初等函数
items.summary: A paper reports that the single binary operator eml(x,y) = exp(x) − ln(y), together with the constant 1, can generate the standard functions of a scientific calculator, including arithmetic operations and constants such as e and pi. The author says the operator was found through systematic exhaustive search and established constructively to be sufficient.

items.title: Want to write a compiler? Just read these two papers (2008)
items.title_zh: 想写编译器？读这两篇论文就够了（2008）
items.summary: A 2008 post argues that programming should be about implementing ideas rather than technology for its own sake, and imagines a beginner being pointed to advanced books such as The Art of Computer Programming.

items.title: Show HN: MDV – a Markdown superset for docs, dashboards, and slides with data
items.title_zh: Show HN：MDV——面向文档、仪表板与幻灯片的数据化 Markdown 超集
items.summary: MDV is a Markdown superset for documents, dashboards and slides with embedded data and visualizations, offering HTML and PDF export, live preview and a VS Code extension.

items.title_zh: 马斯克将推出 XChat，推进微信式超级应用布局
items.summary: X, Elon Musk's social media platform formerly known as Twitter, said its instant messaging app XChat will launch on the Apple App Store on April 17 as part of a push toward a WeChat-like super app.

items.title: Samsung to scale back appliances, TV and display businesses in China, sources say
items.title_zh: 消息称三星将收缩在华家电、电视与显示业务
items.summary: TechNode reports, citing sources, that Samsung plans to scale back its appliances, TV and display businesses in China.

items.title: Honor denies talks with ByteDance on Doubao AI phone collaboration
items.title_zh: 荣耀否认与字节跳动就豆包 AI 手机合作进行洽谈
items.summary: Honor denied recent media reports that it was in discussions with ByteDance about potential cooperation on a Doubao AI smartphone, according to TechNode.

items.title: DJI to launch Lito X1 series on April 23, likely to feature 360-degree obstacle avoidance system
items.title_zh: 大疆将于 4 月 23 日发布 Lito X1 系列，或配备 360 度避障系统
items.summary: DJI said it will launch its Lito X1 series on April 23, expected to be the debut of its first new consumer drone line.

items.title: JD.com launches robot ambulance service, plans expansion to 50+ cities across China
items.title_zh: 京东推出机器人救护车服务，计划覆盖全国 50 多座城市
items.summary: JD.com launched a robot ambulance service on Wednesday, offering maintenance and repair for humanoid robots, quadruped robots and AI companions. The report says the company plans to expand the service to more than 50 cities across China.

items.title: Tesla completes AI5 chip tape-out, to be manufactured by TSMC and Samsung
items.title_zh: 特斯拉完成 AI5 芯片流片，将由台积电与三星代工
items.summary: Elon Musk said Tesla has completed the tape-out of its next-generation AI5 chip. He thanked TSMC and Samsung, which the report says will manufacture it.

items.title: Tesla considers humanoid robot production at Shanghai Gigafactory
items.title_zh: 特斯拉考虑在上海超级工厂生产人形机器人
items.summary: Tesla is considering producing humanoid robots at its Shanghai Gigafactory, a plant that has been making electric vehicles since 2019, according to TechNode.

items.title: NikolayS/PgQue
items.title_zh: NikolayS/PgQue：基于 PgQ 的轻量级 Postgres 队列
items.summary: PgQue is a "zero-bloat" Postgres queue built on Skype's PgQ, installed with a single SQL file and ticked by pg_cron.

items.title: OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills
items.title_zh: OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills —— 模块化办公助手技能
items.summary: A JavaScript repository providing modular SenseNova skills for building AI-powered office assistants and productivity workflows.

items.title: Manavarya09/design-extract
items.title_zh: Manavarya09/design-extract：一键提取网站设计系统
items.summary: design-extract extracts a website's complete design system with one command, producing DTCG tokens and providing an MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor and Windsurf, plus emitters for iOS, Android, Flutter, WordPress, Tailwind and Figma.

items.title: SteveTheKiller/KillerPDF
items.title_zh: SteveTheKiller/KillerPDF：Windows 上的开源 PDF 编辑器
items.summary: A free, open-source PDF editor for Windows built on a PDF 2.0 engine. It supports viewing, annotating, OCR, merging, splitting, cropping, rotating, comparing, text editing, drawing, signing, form filling, printing and opening password-protected files without a subscription.

items.title: Ademking/MD-This-Page
items.title_zh: Ademking/MD-This-Page：一键把网页转成 Markdown
items.summary: A TypeScript tool that converts any web page into clean, readable Markdown in one click.

items.title: AndrewPrifer/liquid-dom
items.title_zh: liquid-dom：把 Liquid Glass 带到 Web
items.summary: Liquid DOM is a TypeScript project that brings a Liquid Glass look to the web.

items.title: HKUSTDial/Supervisor-Skills
items.title_zh: HKUSTDial/Supervisor-Skills：把导师十年科研经验做成 AI 技能
items.summary: Supervisor-Skills distills a PhD supervisor's decade of research experience into callable AI skills meant to serve as a research co-advisor from idea generation through paper submission.

items.title: uber/ADR
items.title_zh: uber/ADR：企业 AI Agent 安全框架
items.summary: ADR, described as deployed at Uber, secures enterprise AI agents through observability, security benchmarking and threat detection.

items.title: patterniha/MITM-DomainFronting
items.title_zh: patterniha/MITM-DomainFronting：MITM 接收、域前置发送
items.summary: The project pairs a man-in-the-middle setup that receives unencrypted data with domain fronting to send it onward, and is written as a Batchfile.

items.title: Predict and Reconstruct: Joint Objectives for Self-Supervised Language Representation Learning
items.title_zh: 预测与重建：自监督语言表示学习的联合目标
items.summary: Researchers at NVIDIA propose a hybrid pre-training objective that combines a JEPA-style latent-space prediction loss with masked language modelling over a single shared encoder, using a learnable scalar to balance the two. Pretrained on English Wikipedia with matched compute, the hybrid encoder produced more uniform embeddings and encoded less surface-level lexical information than a pure-MLM baseline, while linear-probe accuracy was similar.

items.title: Aethon: A Reference-Based Replication Primitive for Constant-Time Instantiation of Stateful AI Agents
items.title_zh: Aethon：面向有状态 AI 智能体的近常数时间实例化复制原语
items.summary: Aethon is a reference-based replication primitive that represents each stateful AI agent as a compositional view over stable definitions, layered memory and local context instead of materializing full objects. The authors say this decouples creation cost from inherited structure and supports lighter instantiation for multi-agent orchestration and enterprise governance.

items.title: Text-Attributed Knowledge Graph Enrichment with Large Language Models for Medical Concept Representation
items.title_zh: 用大语言模型丰富文本属性知识图谱，实现医学概念表示
items.summary: The paper presents MedCo, an LLM-powered graph learning framework that builds a medical-code knowledge graph, enriches it into a text-attributed graph with generated node descriptions and edge rationales, and jointly trains a LoRA-tuned LLaMA encoder with a heterogeneous GNN.

items.title: Predicting Where Steering Vectors Succeed
items.title_zh: 预测引导向量在何处生效
items.summary: The paper introduces the Linear Accessibility Profile (LAP), a training-free per-layer diagnostic that applies a model's unembedding matrix to intermediate hidden states to predict whether steering vectors will work. Across 24 binary concept families on five models from Pythia-2.8B to Llama-8B, the peak score predicted steering effectiveness with correlations of +0.86 to +0.91, and an entity-steering demo confirmed the recommended layer on Gemma-2-2B and OLMo-2-1B-Instruct.

items.title: GraphDC: A Divide-and-Conquer Multi-Agent System for Scalable Graph Algorithm Reasoning
items.title_zh: GraphDC：面向可扩展图算法推理的分治多智能体系统
items.summary: GraphDC is a divide-and-conquer multi-agent framework for graph algorithm reasoning that splits an input graph into subgraphs, assigns each to a specialized agent and uses a master agent to combine the local results with inter-subgraph information. The authors report it consistently outperforms existing methods, especially on larger graphs.

items.title: Topology-Aware Data Movement for Disaggregated GPU Inference
items.title_zh: 面向解耦式 GPU 推理的拓扑感知数据搬运
items.summary: The paper designs a topology-aware transfer orchestrator for disaggregated LLM inference that discovers the interconnect hierarchy at startup and picks the best transport for each KV-cache transfer, projecting 3–18× lower transfer latency than the uniform RDMA used by systems such as DistServe, Splitwise and Mooncake. The authors note that full evaluation requires multi-node clusters and CXL 3.0 hardware not yet available in GPU clouds.

items.title: Multi-Agent Object Detection Framework Based on Raspberry Pi YOLO Detector and Slack-Ollama Natural Language Interface
items.title_zh: 基于 Raspberry Pi YOLO 检测器与 Slack-Ollama 自然语言界面的多智能体目标检测框架
items.summary: The paper describes a prototype edge object-detection system that runs a YOLO vision agent, a Slack chatbot agent and an Ollama LLM reporting agent locally on a single Raspberry Pi, orchestrated through event-based message exchange.

items.title: Debate as Reward: A Multi-Agent Reward System for Scientific Ideation via RL Post-Training
items.title_zh: 以辩论为奖励：面向科学构思的 RL 后训练多智能体奖励系统
items.summary: The authors propose a multi-agent reward function for RL post-training of scientific idea generation, intended to resist reward hacking, and train with an unbiased Group Relative Policy Optimization variant on the ICLR-320 dataset; they report it outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on expert-evaluated novelty, feasibility and effectiveness.
